scope: Hypothetical rest-to-rest 1 km matched-arrival study. Best feasible tested controls only; no global optimality, calibrated LRT-2 performance or measured savings claim.

evidence.basis: Declared 2026-10-18 in docs/experiments.md. 85 s +/- 0.1 s is a synthetic target, not a timetable. Cap/coast bounds are search choices; both grid spacings are halved and observed cap/time crossings bisected nine times. Search stability uses 0.1 MJ (about 0.028 kWh), distinct from integration tolerance. Robustness replays fixed controls; ranges are not confidence intervals. All physical/electrical inputs inherit scenario provenance.
